candidates.change_summary: Replace the balance update so it sets the balance to msg.value instead of adding to the existing balance.
Replace the unlockTime assignment so it always stores _unlockTime instead of the maximum of _unlockTime and the current timestamp.
Change the lock release in nonReentrant_ to set locked_ to true instead of false, permanently locking Put after the first call.
Delete the LogFile.AddMessage call in Collect so successful collections are no longer recorded in the log.
Delete the balance update after the external call, so collected amounts are never deducted from the holder's balance.
Change the balance condition from >= to > so collecting exactly the full balance is no longer allowed.
Delete the `locked_ = true;` statement so the nonReentrant_ modifier no longer locks, allowing reentrancy during Collect.
